title: Unique Light Irish Mung Bean Sprouts Pasta
description: A light and refreshing Irish dish featuring mung bean sprouts, Mediterranean friendly flavors, and a unique cheese pull, made with fermented mung bean sprout sukjju.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the mung bean sprouts to the skillet and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Drain the pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the mung bean sprout mixture.
Crumble the feta cheese over the top of the pasta and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve immediately and enjoy the unique cheese pull.
